ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (off-white) pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible fluke area, with high-contrast low-intensity (black) pixels forming a continuous boundary and internal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes consist of high-intensity contiguous regions. A low-intensity border of variable thickness tracks the trailing edge and tips. Multiple discrete low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) are localized in the central and lower regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression at the central nexus with an estimated interior angle of 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous linear boundary; pixel-amplitude of valleys is greatest on the distal tips, becoming more shallow towards the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a convex curve sweeping upwards and outwards from the submerged lower attachment point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distributed small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters (3-10 pixels) against the high-intensity background, predominantly on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, dark, unaligned horizontal linear feature approximately 50 pixels in length situated in the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable dark linear mark on the left lobe and irregular dark spotting across both lobes consistent with non-pigmentary surface disruptions.
